required_fixes: Add a disclosure describing the processes used to identify, assess, prioritise and monitor (i) sustainability-related opportunities (IFRS S1 44(b)) and (ii) climate-related opportunities, including whether/how climate-related scenario analysis informs identification of climate-related opportunities (IFRS S2 25(b)).

Add an explicit statement explaining whether and how climate-related (and sustainability-related) risks are prioritised relative to other types of risk within the entity’s overall risk management/ERM process (IFRS S1 44(a)(iv); IFRS S2 25(a)(iv)).

Add evidence-backed wording (or provide evidence) that scenario analysis outputs are used as an input to risk identification/assessment; otherwise rephrase to a narrower, evidenced claim such as: 'Risks are linked to internal scenario references (SCN0005, SCN0007, SCN0009, SCN0011) for traceability.'

Either (a) provide evidence of prioritisation (priority ranking/escalation/management attention fields or governance artifacts) or (b) rephrase prioritisation language as a methodological intent rather than an implemented process.

Clarify whether severity_score and overall score are recorded fields in the register; if not evidenced, rephrase to align with available evidence (methodology description only) or add evidence items showing severity_score/overall score.
Minor consistency fix: align 'semi-annual' wording with the register value naming (or state it as 'semi-annual (semi_annual in the register)').

approval_policy: V9.1: deterministic evidence/fact gates are binding; style judge is advisory unless IFRS_STYLE_JUDGE_MODE=blocking.

section_generation_score.policy: Missing requirements reduce audit/readiness visibility only; they must not appear in report prose.
